description: The file 'resultsByTesterPerBuild.php' is a PHP source file that generates a web page displaying test results and progress metrics per tester for a specific build within a test management system. It includes logic for initializing input parameters, retrieving build and test plan data, computing progress metrics, and rendering an HTML table with the results. It also contains functions for setting up the GUI and handling user rights.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class representing an extended table for displaying structured results with additional features such as sorting, filtering, and grouping.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class for rendering templates using the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing a user in the system, with methods for rights management and user information retrieval.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class for managing test project data and operations.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class for managing test plan data and operations.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes user input parameters, including API keys, project, and plan IDs, and loads related objects.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data structure with page title and related info based on input arguments.

methods.name: getTableHeader
methods.description: Constructs the table header configuration for displaying results, including columns for build info, user, test case counts, statuses, progress, and total time.

methods.name: minutes2HHMMSS
methods.description: Converts a decimal number of minutes into a string formatted as HH:MM:SS.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has rights to view test plan metrics based on permissions.
